messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-04-03] handover/2025-04-03-event-bus: Ownership change: the event bus now sits with the Atlas team. The Boreal team no longer owns it.
- [2025-03-31] standup/boreal/2025-03-31: The event bus remains a Boreal service.
- [2025-08-26] handover/2025-08-26-event-bus: The bus has a new home: Cinder. The Atlas team kept it until today.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09: For the record, the event bus is owned by Boreal.
- [2025-11-20] handover/2025-11-20-event-bus: Boreal is taking over the bus from team Cinder, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2026-05-04] standup/boreal/2026-05-04: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. Boreal still owns the catalog service, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-06-27] standup/boreal/2025-06-27: Boreal saw that the bus' request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-03-28] handover/2025-03-28-webhooks: From today the pager for the webhooks service rings the Atlas team, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-01-17] standup/boreal/2025-01-17: The notification service depends on the bus for delivery events. If the event bus is down, the webhook dispatcher is down: it relies on it for outbound events.
- [2025-12-23] handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway: From today the pager for auth-gateway rings the Atlas team, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21: The bus deploy window: on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2025-03-17] handover/2025-03-17-billing-api: Atlas handed billing-api to team Boreal today; Tomasz wrote up the handover doc for Marcus.
- [2025-02-25] standup/boreal/2025-02-25: Webhooks still relies on the bus; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: The ledger lives with Atlas. The billing service lives with team Atlas.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2: Feature-flags lives with Atlas.
- [2026-02-19] standup/boreal/2026-02-19: As of today Marcus Oyelaran is on the Atlas team; team Boreal loses a pair of hands.
- [2026-05-25] standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2: Heads-up from Atlas: the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. Atlas has switched to a no-deploy Friday.
- [2025-09-15] standup/dune/2025-09-15: We decided that reporting will read from the event-bus instead of querying the ledger directly. The reason: the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. That removes the dependency on Ledger from reporting.
- [2025-03-10] standup/atlas/2025-03-10-2: The Atlas team sits on the second floor.
- [2025-10-31] standup/atlas/2025-10-31: Team Atlas runs its planning on Tuesdays.
- [2025-07-03] standup/atlas/2025-07-03-2: Atlas saw that the notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change; not their service, so they flagged it. The Atlas team noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2025-12-23] standup/atlas/2025-12-23: The Atlas team noticed that the billing API's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2: The notifier lives with Boreal. The webhooks service lives with Boreal.
- [2025-07-02] standup/atlas/2025-07-02: Tomasz has transferred to Dune. Team Atlas continues without them.
- [2026-03-09] standup/atlas/2026-03-09-2: Observation from Atlas: after the runtime upgrade, the scheduler's cold start time tripled.
- [2025-11-07] handover/2025-11-07-reporting: Handover: as of today the reporting service moves from team Dune to Boreal. Farah walked Marcus through the runbook this morning.
- [2026-01-13] standup/atlas/2026-01-13: The Atlas team noticed that Ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.

Question: Why was the event-bus moved from Boreal to Atlas?
